settings.heading: Stock Playmate Labs
settings.body: Design-led sexual wellness, made in the UK. Soft enough for your marketing team to talk about in public, distinctive enough to be worth the shelf.

settings.title: It has sold before
settings.text: Our first listing with a major UK retailer opened at 50 units, sold through in a week, and moved to repeat orders in the thousands across the Christmas peak.

settings.title: It photographs well
settings.text: Designed in-house and shot in our own studio. Every product comes with retail-ready assets, so your team is not building a listing from a packshot and a paragraph.

settings.title: It is talkable in public
settings.text: Sexual wellness that a marketing team can actually promote. No explicit packaging, nothing that has to be hidden behind a click-through.

settings.title: It is made here
settings.text: Formulated and produced in the UK in small runs, with full ingredient and allergen documentation available for your compliance team.

settings.question: Where do you ship to?
settings.answer: TO CONFIRM: territories you supply, and whether the formulations are compliant in the EU and elsewhere.

settings.question: Can we get samples before committing?
settings.answer: Yes, always. Tell us what you are considering and we will send the products with trade pricing.

settings.question: What are your payment terms?
settings.answer: TO CONFIRM: your standard terms for a first order and for established accounts.

settings.question: Do you supply marketing assets?
settings.answer: Yes. Product photography, lifestyle imagery and copy are supplied with every order, so your team is not building a listing from a packshot and a paragraph.

settings.question: What documentation can you provide?
settings.answer: Full ingredient, allergen and nutritional declarations, product specifications and barcodes. Tell us what your compliance team needs and we will send it.

settings.question: Is the packaging suitable for open display?
settings.answer: Yes, and that is deliberate. Nothing in the range is explicit on the outside, so it can sit on an open shelf and be promoted through public channels.

settings.question: Do you work with distributors?
settings.answer: TO CONFIRM: whether you supply distributors, and any territory exclusivity.

settings.question: Can you do exclusives or own-brand collaborations?
settings.answer: We have done retailer collaborations before, including co-branded packaging. Tell us what you have in mind.

settings.heading: Questions we get from buyers
settings.footer_text: Per-product numbers are all in the brochure.
